claims.sourceText: The National Archives Discovery catalogue, search API, https://discovery.nationalarchives.gov.uk/API/search/records?sps.searchQuery=%22Joint%20Air%20Reconnaissance%20Intelligence%20Centre%22
claims.text: The unit's record trail is continuous and official. The National Archives catalogue holds Operations Record Books for the Joint Air Reconnaissance Intelligence Centre (United Kingdom) from AIR 29/1361, RAF Station Nuneham Park, September to December 1950, to AIR 29/5764, RAF Brampton, 1992, in the series 'Air Ministry and Ministry of Defence: Operations Record Books, Miscellaneous Units', with 'JARIC (UK): administrative history', 1962-1972, at AIR 14/4103.

edges.label: Ministry of Defence imagery-intelligence unit with Operations Record Books at Kew, 1950-1992
edges.note: The unit's Operations Record Books are catalogued in the Air Ministry and Ministry of Defence series AIR 29, from RAF Nuneham Park in 1950 to RAF Brampton in 1992, with a separate administrative history at AIR 14/4103.
